newsitem.title: USA: Nu-kote Holding sees operating profit.
newsitem.headline: Nu-kote Holding sees operating profit.

text.p: Nu-kote Holding Inc said Thursday that in response to a question by an analyst in a conference call Thursday, David Brigante, chairman and chief executive, said he expects Nu-kote to be profitable on an operating basis in the fiscal fourth quarter ending March 31, 1997.
Nu-kote said it manages a global portfolio of companies in the imaging supplies industry.
Nu-kote said it produces supplies for printers, copiers, fax machines and ink jet printers in the U.S., Europe, and Latin America.
